seasons.title: Log holds all five ladders
seasons.body: At this checkpoint, Log leads all five Season 135 boards: Surge at **11.720s**, Higher / Lower at **73**, Trade at **38.847s** on its one-entry board, Survival at **120** with a 95.530s tiebreak, and Rain at **145**. All five leading runs are Cleared, and Surge carries this season's Free Pass race through September 7—[check the boards](/#/leaderboards) and [read the rules](https://poapkings.com/elixir-drop/free-pass/).

seasons.title: The bridge gets steeper
seasons.body: Season 135's bridge is getting crowded: Log leads Surge at **11.720s**, Higher / Lower at **109**, Trade at **38.847s**, Survival at **120** (95.530s tiebreak), and Rain at **145**. All five leading runs are Cleared, Trade now has two visible entries, and Surge carries the Free Pass—[check the boards](/#/leaderboards) and [read the rules](https://poapkings.com/elixir-drop/free-pass/).
